title: Pokémon Showdown
prompt: Create one landscape 16:9 Worldlet Village background plate for a Pokémon Showdown strategy-game applet. Reference 1 is the existing scene style; reference 2 is its existing icon identity. Make a friendly sunlit village board-game clubhouse terrace, polished sculpted storybook illustration, cream stone and timber, flowers and warm brass. On the left, a large completely blank ivory board occupying x5–65%, y14–81%, near-front-facing with a thin blue wooden frame, unobstructed space for future HTML. On the right, detailed strategy-game clubhouse furniture: wooden storage drawers, small red-and-white circular game tokens, notebooks, brass timer, fabric cushions, plant pots and game-rule books. A modest Pokemon Showdown name plaque is attached to a storage drawer. No characters or creatures, no weapons, no violence, no battles depicted. Match the icon colors and village style. Do not render UI or sample data.
